The correlation between the Democratic candidate's perceived competence and the Democratic-minus-Republican vote share differential is about 0.433. I took the differential as (d.votes − r.votes) / (d.votes + r.votes), meaning the margin as a share of the two-party vote.

If you used the raw vote difference (d.votes − r.votes) instead, the correlation would be much lower, about 0.141.

ANSWER: 0.433
